lens: browser UX, accessibility, responsiveness and user flows

findings.claim: Main timer actions lose keyboard focus when their replacement button has a different action name.
findings.scenario: Focus Commit and press Enter; focus Start and press Enter; focus Pause and press Enter.
findings.evidence: In each case document.activeElement becomes BODY. After Start, Tab focuses the Faff logo rather than Pause. New timer/rating views have no fallback focus target. Reproduced in Chromium at 1024x768.

findings.claim: The rating undo toast remains above an open modal and exposes an action outside the modal.
findings.scenario: Complete and rate a session, then immediately open Daily plan and options while the 9-second undo toast remains.
findings.evidence: At 390x844 the toast at y=695..741 obscures the end-day row in the options sheet. Its Undo button is outside the inert header/body/dock and clicking it closes the modal and reverses the rating. app.css assigns toast z-index 6 versus backdrop 5.

findings.claim: Reloading a history URL renders the home timer instead of history.
findings.scenario: Open Calendar, open today's sessions, then reload the resulting index.html#history URL.
findings.evidence: Before reload .history-page is visible. After reload URL remains #history but main has class app-body timer-page; startup parser recognizes only #calendar although popstate recognizes #history.

findings.claim: Importing JSON null displays a JavaScript exception instead of the intended invalid-backup message.
findings.scenario: Settings > restore backup > select a JSON file containing only null.
findings.evidence: Toast text is Cannot read properties of null (reading 'kind'). Saved state remains intact.

refuted.claim: Conflicting top and bottom rules make the toast excessively tall.
refuted.evidence: calendar.css overrides top:auto. Measured toast height 46px on desktop and mobile.

refuted.claim: Landscape sheets make backup controls inaccessible.
refuted.evidence: At 667x375 outer and sheet scrolling reveal Restore backup and keyboard Escape still closes the sheet. Some content starts outside viewport but controls remain reachable.

coverage.baseline: tests/browser.cjs passed fully using scratch artifact output: timer progression, pause/reload, plan edits, rating/undo/correction, offline reload and completion, calendar/streak, backup export/restore, simultaneous ratings across windows, midnight recovery, 320/360/412/1024 layouts; no page errors.
coverage.additional: Keyboard focus across commit/start/pause/resume and completion; dialog Tab/Shift+Tab/Escape and return focus; overlapping modal/toast interaction; history reload; malformed JSON backup; initial plan/calendar/settings layout at 320x568,360x640,390x844,667x375,844x390,1024x768,320x256; landscape backup control reachability.
coverage.limitations: Chromium only; no real screen reader, device notification delivery, physical install or actual Android suspension tested. Probe's immediate timer-layout measurements were not awaited and are excluded from timer layout conclusions; baseline timer layout checks used explicit expectations. No repository writes performed.
